Setup, and every item in the release: [README.md](README.md). Online: https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/card.md A surface for grouped content, rendered as a `
` or the element you pass to `render`. A child with the `ld-concentric` class keeps its corners concentric with the card's. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @lede/card ``` The command needs Lede's registry in `components.json`, as [README.md](README.md#use-it-in-a-shadcn-project) shows. It also installs the items [`lede-theme`](lede-theme.md) and [`lede-utils`](lede-utils.md), and the npm packages `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`. The item's JSON, with each file's source, is https://lede.cloudcompute.com/r/v0.8.0/card.json. ## Import ```tsx import { Card } from '@/components/lede/card'; ``` ## Files and exports | Installs to | Import from | Exports | | --- | --- | --- | | `components/lede/card.tsx` | `@/components/lede/card` | `Card` (component), `CardProps` (type) | ## Props A neutral `
` by default. Pass `render={

Default `'md'`. | | `padding` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `sm` | Inner padding: `'sm'` is `--space-2`, `'md'` is `--space-4`, `'lg'` is `--space-6`. Default `'sm'`.
